description.zh:
是否开启绑定小程序：
- **Y**：开启
- **N（默认）**：不开启
><notice>如果开启绑定小程序，请确认传递绑定小程序的所有参数。></notice>
description.en:
Specifies whether to bind a mini program. Valid values:
- **Y**: enabled.
- **N (default)**: disabled.
><notice>If you enable mini program binding, make sure that you specify all parameters related to the mini program binding.></notice>.
The content of the uploaded verification file.
The name of the uploaded verification file.

description.zh:
设备增强检测能力：
- **Y**：开启
- **N**：关闭
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable enhanced device risk detection. Valid values:
- **Y**: enabled.
- **N**: disabled.
The name of the mini program.

description.zh:
绑定小程序平台：
- **WECHAT**：微信
- **ALIPAY**：支付宝
- **TIKTOK**：抖音
description.en:
The mini program platform. Valid values:
- **WECHAT**: WeChat
- **ALIPAY**: Alipay
- **TIKTOK**: TikTok.

description.zh: 返照数量（1-5），开启storeImage认证文件留存后生效。
description.en: The number of returned photos (1 to 5). This parameter takes effect only after StoreImage is enabled for certification file retention.

description.zh: 返视频时长（1-2秒），开启storeImage生效。
description.en: The duration of the returned video (1 to 2 seconds). This parameter takes effect only after StoreImage is enabled.
This parameter is not used. You do not need to specify this parameter.

description.zh:
是否开启投递认证过程产生的认证文件到用户的OSS：
- **Y**：开启
- **N（默认）**：关闭
description.en:
Specifies whether to deliver certification files generated during the certification process to the user's OSS bucket. Valid values:
- **Y**: enabled.
- **N (default)**: disabled.

descriptions.zh:
根据场景Id更新金融级认证场景的信息。
- 服务地址：cloudauth.aliyuncs.com。
- 请求方法：HTTPS POST。
descriptions.en:
Updates the information of a China Finance Certification Initiative (CFCI) scenario based on the scenario ID.
- Service endpoint: cloudauth.aliyuncs.com.
- Request method: HTTPS POST.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudauth update-ant-cloud-auth-scene --scene-id 1000013372 --status 1 --scene-name test --store-image Y --bind-mini-program Y --mini-program-name '测试APP' --platform IOS --check-file-name '测试.txt' --check-file-body 774c4aab45981ff4a86cde9255a11xxx --return-pic-count 1 --return-video-length 2 --device-risk-plus Y --api-version 2019-03-07 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudauth UpdateAntCloudAuthScene --region cn-hangzhou --SceneId 1000013372 --Status 1 --SceneName test --Platform IOS --StoreImage Y --ReturnPicCount 1 --ReturnVideoLength 2 --DeviceRiskPlus Y --CheckFileBody 774c4aab45981ff4a86cde9255a11xxx --MiniProgramName '测试APP' --BindMiniProgram Y --CheckFileName '测试.txt'
